svg.title: Document Analyzer: Copy, Choose, Compose
svg.desc: A supplier PDF, a document or form, goes into an analyzer: a prebuilt analyzer such as invoice, receipt or layout, or a custom analyzer based on prebuilt-document with your field schema. Each field uses one method: extract copies a value on the page and works only for documents; classify picks one value from a fixed list; generate writes a value, such as a summary. The result is named fields, for example VendorName, DocumentCategory and Summary. Confidence and grounding appear only if estimateFieldSourceAndConfidence is enabled, which is off by default; low-confidence fields go to human review. Most analyzers need a chat completion model and an embeddings model deployed as defaults; read and layout need none.
svg.text: An analyzer applies a schema to a document; each field is extracted, classified or generated.
